<tjsInfo:
(Magic Item) A Magic Flower will bestow a 
magical enchantment upon one individual, 
which lasts for a limited amount of time.  
The flower is consumed in the process.  
The enchantment offers enhancements to 
ability scores and partial protection from 
ability-score-lowering debuffs.  
>
<tjsInfo2:
    Magic flowers have distant ancestry
that goes back thousands of years to
planet Earth, and very far back are
relatives of flowering plant species
native to Earth, which were brought to
Acrydia and nine other worlds by the
ancient natives of the ten worlds that
brought in life from Earth and
terraformed their ten worlds into being
like that of Earth, although with the
imported Earth-origin life being gifted
with magic that became natural to the
spirit of all such life, resulting in
plants, animals, and people from Earth
having magical gifts that would vary from
individual to individual.\LB
    Magic flowers are of course an
example of such enchanted life, a
non-sentient plant species that has a
highly magical nature that is tied to
the spirit of the plant.  Such flowers
grow in the wilderness as well as magic
gardens of people of the ten magical
worlds, and are edible plants that can
be safely eaten raw for nutrition and
magical benefits, as well as being used
as an ingredient in both foods and
magic potions, oils, bread, and other
magical and herbal products that include
various foods and medicines.\LB
    Once they are picked from the plant
that bears them, magic flowers will last
a suprisingly long time before they
start to go bad and decay if they are not
consumed.  On the other hand, there isn't
any reliable method of preserving them to
make them last longer, although the
flowers themselves can be preservatives
for other perishable foods and products,
which is why breads and pastries baked
with magic flowers as an ingredient last
a rather long time before going stale.
>
